app.description: Extract accompaniment from music with a private AI runtime.

input.placeholder: Select an audio file or folder

compatibility44100.title: Compatibility mode (recommended)
compatibility44100.description: Processes at 44.1 kHz for a more stable residual.

sourceSampleRate.title: Preserve sample rate (experimental)
sourceSampleRate.description: Attempts to match the source rate; some files can have alignment differences.

environment.title: AI runtime
environment.notInstalledDetail: First use requires about {{download}} of downloads and {{disk}} of disk space.
environment.installingDetail: Runtime setup is already running. Keep this window open.
environment.repairDetail: The runtime needs repair before extraction can start.
environment.unsupportedDetail: This system does not meet the runtime requirements.

initialization.title: Initialize AI runtime
initialization.description: The first setup downloads the private runtime. Later processing can run offline.

cancellation.title: Cancel task?
cancellation.initializationConsequence: Runtime initialization will stop. You can resume setup later.
cancellation.processingConsequence: The current song will stop processing. Songs already completed remain in the output directory.

completion.title: Extraction complete
completion.summary: Completed items are kept in the output directory.

error.title: Task could not be completed
error.recovery: Review the diagnostic code and try again after resolving the issue.
error.generic: The task could not be completed. Try again after resolving the issue.
error.environmentDownload: The runtime download could not be completed.
error.environmentNotInitialized: Initialize the AI runtime before starting extraction.
error.environmentDownloadFailed: The runtime download failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.environmentHashMismatch: A downloaded runtime file could not be verified. Try initialization again.
error.pythonSyncFailed: The private Python environment could not be prepared.
error.modelDownloadFailed: The separation model could not be downloaded.
error.ffmpegNotAvailable: The audio tools are unavailable. Repair the runtime and try again.
error.inputUnsupported: This input audio file is not supported.
error.outputNotWritable: The selected output directory is not writable.
error.pathUnsupported: This path cannot be passed safely to the audio tools. Choose a shorter standard drive or network path.
error.cudaNotAvailable: A compatible NVIDIA CUDA device is not available.
error.cudaOutOfMemory: The GPU ran out of memory. Close other GPU applications and try again.
error.inferenceFailed: The separation model could not process this audio file.
error.postprocessFailed: The accompaniment output could not be created.
error.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Review the selected paths and options.
error.settingsInvalid: Saved settings are invalid and need to be updated.
error.manifestInvalid: The runtime configuration is invalid. Repair the runtime and try again.
error.localDataUnavailable: The application data directory is unavailable.

license.title: Open-source attribution
license.description: Full license notices are embedded in this application.
license.loadFailed: The embedded license notices could not be loaded. Try again.
